core.title: Bluetooth Enabled Fingerprint and Keypad Smart Deadbolt with Bridge, Ultraloq U-BOLT-PRO-UB01
tags: Bluetooth Enabled Fingerprint and Keypad Smart Deadbolts
U-BOLT Bluetooth Smart Deadbolt with Fingerprint Readers

text.description_html:
Ultraloq U-BOLT-PRO-UB01, U-Bolt 5 in 1 Smart Deadbolt with Bridge

  • Remote Access: Unlock your U-BOLT Deadbolt or grant access to guests. You will receive a smartphone notiﬁcation when someone opens your door.
  • Share Temporary Codes and Ekeys: The App allows you to create temporary codes and Ekeys for your guests so you can grant access for specific dates or periods of time remotely with no monthly charges.
  • Works with Amazon Echo or Google Home
  • Bluetooth Smart Connectivity: Your Smartphone is your key. Just unlock your deadbolt with the U-tec App on your smartphone.
  • Unlocks When You Come To Your Door
  • 360 Degree Live Fingerprint ID: Unlock your front door fast and accurately with fingerprint detection from any angle.
  • Magic Shake: Just shake your phone to unlock your door without unlocking your phone.
  • Anti-Peep Password: Add random digits before your passcode to protect your passcode from prying eyes.
  • Auto Lock: Can re-lock automatically for added security and convenience.
  • Front Lock Micro-USB for Emergency Power: Unlock you door even when the batteries are dead by using an external battery to activate your lock. It also has a manual key slot hidden under the faceplate.

More Features of the Ultraloq U-BOLT-PRO Smart Deadbolt with Bridge:

  • App allows you to Manage Users and see a Log Record of who’s entered and when.
  • Four to eight digit personal entry code.
  • 60 code capacity and 60 user capacity.
  • Unlock with the app.
  • Backlight
  • No wiring means it is easy to install.
  • Requires 4 AA batteries for up to 1 year (8000 times access)
  • Low battery warning.
  • Mechanical Key Override.
  • Bridge da Encryption: 128-bit AES and a Dynamic Key that will keep you and your data safe.
  • Warranty: 18 Month Electronics and Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Ultraloq UBOLTPRO-UB01 Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Specifications for the U-BOLT Bluetooth Smart Deadbolt with Fingerprint Reader:

  • Material: Solid and Resistant with Durable Zinc Alloy Casing and Weatherproof Exterior Assembly.
  • Finish: Black and Silver
  • Outside Plate Width: 2.95" (75mm) square
  • Outside Plate Projection: .83" (21mm)
  • Inside Plate Width: 2.95" (75mm)
  • Inside Plate Height: 4.92" (125mm)
  • Inside Plate Projection: 1.39" (35.3mm)
  • Bridge Width: 2.67" (68mm)
  • Bridge Height: .89" (22mm)
  • Bridge Projection: 2.05" (52mm)
  • Adjustable Backset for both 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-24/25"
  • Fits 2-1/8" Crossbore Hole (Standard Pre-Drilled Door)
  • Handing: Reversible
  • Keyway: Schalge C Keyway
  • Working Temperature: Outside lock body: -22 ̊F (-30 ̊C) to 149 ̊F (65 ̊C) / Inside lock body: 14 ̊F (-10 ̊C) to 131 ̊F (55 ̊C)
  • Box Includes: Interior Assembly, Exterior Assembly, Wifi Bridge, Interior Assembly Mounting Plate, Strike, Bolt, Backup Key, and mounting hardware.

Also Available U-Bolt Pro Without Wifi Bridge

Sold Individually

seo.title: Bluetooth Enabled Fingerprint and Keypad Smart Deadbolt
seo.description: The Bluetooth Enabled Fingerprint and Keypad Smart Deadbolt has every feature you could want in a smart lock. It features 5 ways to securely gain access: a fingerprint reader, automatic unlock via your smart phone, manual key override, keycode entry, and magic shake (shake your phone to unlock your door). The U-BOLT Smart Deadbolt and Wifi Bridge also works with Alexa, Google Assistant, and IFTTT. With the bridge, you can remotely control entry access to your door from anywhere with your smartphone. It is easy to install with no wiring or drilling required on most standard pre-drilled doors.
